solutions.title: Recursive pair compare
solutions.strategy: Compare the current pair, then recursively compare left and right child pairs.

timeComplexity.explanation: Traversal stops at the first mismatch and otherwise visits paired nodes once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack is bounded by the shorter matching prefix height h.

solutions.title: Iterative pair stack
solutions.strategy: Push corresponding child pairs and reject any value or null-shape mismatch.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each compared node pair is popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack follows pending paired nodes and can grow with tree height h.
